name: Brake Hand Winch
desc: ABLE BHW series manual wire-rope hand winch with spur-gear drive and an automatic load-pressure brake for safe holding and lowering of the load. Lifting capacity 180, 270, 410 and 600 kg (pulling capacity up to 1,200 kg); the winch housing and rope drum are pressed from robust steel plate, with the drum running on bearings. Supplied in a high-visibility green powder-coated finish as standard, or in A304 stainless steel (Model BHW-S). Conforms to and tested per EN 13157:2004+A1:2009, with AS 1418.2 compliance when fitted with approved wire rope and fittings. Note: model HW-800 is supplied without an automatic brake.
